answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36219 Country: India Title: Is riding a bike or a car unlawful for female according to Shariah? Question: Is riding a bike or a car unlawful for female according to Shariah? Answer ID: 36219 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 207/207/M=1433) It is absolutely undesirable for women to drive a car or bike. هكذا فى الفتاوي الرحيمية ج 6 ص 425 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
